title: senna pendula var. tenuifolia
intro: Senna pendula var. tenuifolia, commonly known as Chilean senna, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family that is native to the Andean region of South America. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural laxative, helping to relieve constipation and promote bowel movements. The therapeutic actions of Senna pendula var. tenuifolia include stimulating the digestive system and increasing gut motility, while its bioactive constituents include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and chrysophanol, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various gastrointestinal disorders, including irritable bowel syndrome and dyspepsia.
